set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=2522356e05e775bdbd22334745acc7ed95428652; git fetch origin work/phase1-live-call-probes; git checkout work/phase1-live-call-probes; git reset --hard origin/work/phase1-live-call-probes; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"; export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"; GRADLE="$HOME/.gradle/local-agent/gradle-9.6.0/bin/gradle"; "$GRADLE" :app:assembleDebug --no-daemon; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state)" = device; MODEL=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d ''); API=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.build.version.sdk | tr -d ''); CALL_STATE_BEFORE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry 2>/dev/null | grep -m1 'mCallState=' | cut -d= -f2 | tr -d '[:space:]'); BLUETOOTH_BEFORE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '[:space:]'); SHIZUKU_BEFORE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A -o USER,PID,NAME | grep -E '^shell[[:space:]]+[0-9]+[[:space:]]+shizuku_server$' || true); echo MODEL=$MODEL; echo API=$API; echo CALL_STATE_BEFORE=$CALL_STATE_BEFORE; echo BLUETOOTH_BEFORE=$BLUETOOTH_BEFORE; echo SHIZUKU_BEFORE=$SHIZUKU_BEFORE; test "$MODEL" = SM-S906B; test "$API" = 36; test "$CALL_STATE_BEFORE" = 0; test -n "$SHIZUKU_BEFORE"; APK=app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; test -f "$APK"; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r "$APK" >/tmp/aicall-install.txt; cat /tmp/aicall-install.txt; grep -q Success /tmp/aicall-install.txt; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge/.DiagnosticProbeActivity --ez run_production_media_off_call_smoke true; FOUND=0; for i in $(seq 1 40); do LOG=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -s AiCallBridge:I '*:S'); if printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'production_media_off_call_smoke=PASS'; then FOUND=1; break; fi; if printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -Eq 'production_media_off_call_smoke=(FAIL|REFUSED)|diagnostic_probe_error='; then printf '%s
' "$LOG"; exit 1; fi; sleep 0.5; done; LOG=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -s AiCallBridge:I '*:S'); printf '%s
' "$LOG"; test "$FOUND" = 1; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'reason=expected_off_call_start_rejection'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'states=BINDING>PREPARING>STOPPING>FAILED>IDLE'; ! printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'states=.*ACTIVE'; sleep 2; CALL_STATE_AFTER=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry 2>/dev/null | grep -m1 'mCallState=' | cut -d= -f2 | tr -d '[:space:]'); BLUETOOTH_AFTER=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell settings get global bluetooth_on | tr -d '[:space:]'); HELPER_AFTER=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A -o USER,PID,NAME | grep -F 'pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge:call_media' || true); SHIZUKU_AFTER=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A -o USER,PID,NAME | grep -E '^shell[[:space:]]+[0-9]+[[:space:]]+shizuku_server$' || true); echo CALL_STATE_AFTER=$CALL_STATE_AFTER; echo BLUETOOTH_AFTER=$BLUETOOTH_AFTER; echo HELPER_AFTER=$HELPER_AFTER; echo SHIZUKU_AFTER=$SHIZUKU_AFTER; test "$CALL_STATE_AFTER" = 0; test "$BLUETOOTH_AFTER" = "$BLUETOOTH_BEFORE"; test -z "$HELPER_AFTER"; test -n "$SHIZUKU_AFTER"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo offcall_smoke_s22_green=true
